# Pragmatism Has No A Priori Prejudices Against Theology

Now pragmatism, devoted tho she be to facts, has no such materialistic bias as ordinary empiricism labors under.[^1] Moreover, she has no objection whatever to the realizing of abstractions, so long as you get about among particulars with their aid and they actually carry you somewhere.[^2] Interested in no conclusions but those which our minds and our experiences work out together, she has no a priori prejudices against theology.[^3]

[^1]: [[Pragmatism - Lecture II - What Pragmatism Means#Pragmatism as Mediator Between Empiricism and Religion]] "Now pragmatism, devoted tho she be to facts, has no such materialistic bias as ordinary empiricism labors under."
[^2]: [[Pragmatism - Lecture II - What Pragmatism Means#Pragmatism as Mediator Between Empiricism and Religion]] "Moreover, she has no objection whatever to the realizing of abstractions, so long as you get about among particulars with their aid and they actually carry you somewhere."
[^3]: [[Pragmatism - Lecture II - What Pragmatism Means#Pragmatism as Mediator Between Empiricism and Religion]] "Interested in no conclusions but those which our minds and our experiences work out together, she has no a priori prejudices against theology."
